notes.title: Beholder: Conductor — Release Date Reveal
notes.content:
Beholder: Conductor will be leaving the station and launching April 23rd on Steam. In this spin-off in the Beholder series, you step into the role of a senior conductor on the legendary Determination Bringer train, tasked with monitoring passengers, enforcing strict regulations, and completing high-stakes Ministry assignments that could determine their future. 

[previewyoutube=xwIS1SPvQoA;full][/previewyoutube]
The train is preparing for a long and thrilling journey across the country. 
Your responsibilities include readying the compartments, welcoming the passengers, and enforcing order throughout the route. You will meet people from all corners of the nation. Hear their stories. And decide — who deserves to ride on, and who will be removed from the train.  

As your loyalty to the Ministry deepens, you will unlock access to secret missions that offer rewards and opportunities for promotion. But beware – the journey is filled with risks, including encounters with smugglers, bribery, and corruption. Your choices will shape the lives of passengers — and the course of history, leading to multiple endings. 

Please review and comply with the Ministry’s directives: 


 Monitor all passengers 
 Report their actions and file misconduct notices 
 Conduct baggage searches (preferably unnoticed) 
 Rise through the ranks… or come under investigation 

Ticket price will be disclosed on departure day. New conductors will receive 10% off during the first 10 days after launch 

The Ministry relies on your loyalty:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2825530/Beholder_Conductor

notes.title: Karate Survivor is out now!
notes.content:
Are you ready to unleash your inner martial arts master? Karate Survivor is live, ready to throw you into the gritty, fast-paced world of 80s street brawls! 

In this survivor-like roguelite, every corner of the city is your battleground. Fend off relentless thugs using fists, feet, and anything you can get your hands on – from mop handles to plastic flamingos! Your surroundings are part of your arsenal. Push over scaffolding, swing microwave doors, and turn the world into a weapon. 

[previewyoutube=WH_KjiLuvMg;full][/previewyoutube]
What awaits you in Karate Survivor: 


 Improvised Combat: Use whatever you can get your hands on to dismantle your enemies. Even a toy hammer can be lethal! 
 Environmental Warfare: Manipulate the streets to your advantage. Push objects at enemies, bring down scaffolding, or slam them with a microwave door. 
 Dynamic Combos: Mix and match dozens of attacks into unique six-move combos. Find the most devastating combos to suit your style. 
 Progression and Mastery: Unlock and master techniques that stay with you across runs. Every fight brings you closer to martial arts mastery. 
 Fast-paced Runs and Boss Battles: Face fierce bosses across gritty locations in epic, high-speed showdowns. 

Also, we’ll be adding a new challenge mode as a New Game+ with increased difficulty in an upcoming post-release patch for those eager to test their skills. 

Stay tuned and grab Karate Survivor now with a 10% launch discount. Don’t forget to leave a review to support us!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3027930/Karate_Survivor/

notes.title: Technotopia is Now Available!
notes.content:
Technotopia, a game developed by Yustas and published by Alawar, is now available on Windows and macOS! The city of the future awaits, and it’s your time to take control. 

As the AI Iris, you are tasked with creating the perfect city in a world fractured by social and economic unrest. The metropolis teeters on the edge of chaos, and the balance between competing factions is fragile. Every decision you make will shape the fate of Technotopia – will you build a utopia, or let the city descend into turmoil? 

[previewyoutube=8ZPQsLAHWfg;full][/previewyoutube]

What awaits you in Technotopia: 


 4 Faction-Driven Questlines: Capitalists, aristocrats, politicians, and common citizens all want control of the city. Navigate their conflicting agendas and choose your allies wisely – each storyline will alter the city’s future. 
 100+ Unique Buildings: Construct skyscrapers, parks, residential zones, and industrial hubs. Every building you place will influence the balance of power, helping or hindering different factions. Strategically combine city blocks to maximize efficiency and unlock special bonuses. 
 50+ Dynamic Events: From everyday mishaps to faction conflicts, every event in Technotopia is shaped by your choices, with consequences that ripple across the city. 
 Factions' Influence: Every decision shifts the delicate balance between the city’s ruling groups. Will you appease the elites, or side with the people? 
 City News & Criminal Activity: As crime rises, new challenges emerge, forcing you to make tough decisions. Stay informed through real-time news reports that reflect the impact of your actions on the city's order. 

Get the game with a 10% launch discount and share your feedback on Technotopia – we’re excited to hear your thoughts! Join our Discord to stay up to date on the latest news. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2825110/Technotopia/

notes.title: KIngsgrave, a new game published by Alawar, is out now!
notes.content:
We'd like to provide you Kingsgrave, a gloomy adventure inspired by classic Zelda games. Gain more power and obtain new combat skills as you explore the fractured land, slay foes created by plague, solve puzzles and rebuild villages. Reclaim your realm! 

[previewyoutube=OmVzYrIJYAE;full][/previewyoutube]  

What awaits you on this thorny path: 

 Gather resources, reconstruct buildings, and restore subjects' houses, while defeating enemies to revive the realm and restore its prosperity. Your strength grows with each restoration, solidifying your reign as a wise monarch. 
 Slay plague creatures, purge the land of monsters, and sharpen your combat skills to protect your subjects and restore life to the wastelands. Equip yourself with powerful gear to overcome any foe. 
 Traverse forests, deserts, volcanoes, and catacombs in an interconnected world. Solve challenging puzzles, uncover hidden paths, and navigate perilous terrain on a journey worthy of a true king.
 
The fate of the realm hangs in the balance, awaiting the guiding hand of a true sovereign. Will you answer the call and lead your people to triumph, or will you allow darkness to consume your lands? The choice, dear ruler, is yours to make. Let the legacy of Kingsgrave begin! 

Get the game with a 10% launch discount now:

notes.title: #MinistryofContests
notes.content:
Time to compare notes! Correct answers to the quiz are:

How can you make Order speak?
Once Hector uses all potions from Han van Meegeren, he will offer him a secret one designed to understand the language of animals. Hector will drink it and will have a chance to chat with Order. 
The correct answer is to drink a potion yourself.

Continue the phrase “I hate___, father! I’d rather die than work as a slave!”
When Patrick and Carl talk about Сarl’s new job, Сarl suggests his son start earning money. Patrick says he wouldn't work at the mines.
The correct answer is the mines.

What is Rosa Ranek niece’s name?
Dr. Alloisius Shpak turns to Carl with a request to help him establish his personal life. Carl interrogates the residents and finds out that Rosa Ranek has an unmarried niece Sara Wattermach who will be pleased to meet with the doctor. But when the niece arrives at Krusvice, Rosa understands that it is not her relative, but the imposter Vera Rentsi who makes men fall in love with her and then poison them.
The correct answer is Sara.

What tale can you broadcast through the propaganda machine? 
Anna asks her husband to find her a radio, Сarl buys the radio and gives it to the family. Then there comes a propaganda machine and Danton asks Сarl to set it on the opposition station. If Сarl gives the radio to the wife, then, by entering a special code, you can set the machine on a wise tale of three piglets.
The correct answer is a wise tale of three piglets.

What is Airel Johnson's nickname? 
Airel Johnson is a war hero, an honorary citizen of the State. But once Danton suggests that Airal is the notorious Butcher from Agloe. Karl finds medal for bravery in the battle of Agloe that confirms that Airal is the Butcher.
The correct answer is the Butcher from Agloe.

Congratulations to everyone who answered all the questions correctly! New contest is just around the corner!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/761620/Beholder_2/

notes.content:
The Ministry of Propaganda reports:

The Minister of Agriculture has completed his trial period as prime minister and has taken his office officially since today.  Undoubtedly, staff policy of our Leader is blameless as all other things he has his wise hand in! 

The new Cabinet of Ministers is doing all possible for the benefit of our citizens. Here are the first fruits of the cabinet's labors:
[olist]
The Ministry of Innovations has enabled DualShock 4 and Xbox game controller support.
The Ministry of Controls has added the ability to scale scenes by pressing Num+ and Num-.
The Ministry of Linguistics has improved the Chinese (Simplified) and German translations.
The state has given the Excellence in Service Award to the Ministry of Error Correction for:

Correcting the "Border Disruption" achievement error in Trainee mode;
Correcting the "Solitary Man" achievement error in Trainee mode;
Correcting the error that gave the player a negative balance when he or she did not complete the "Pick up the phone" quest; and
Correcting the error that occasionally allowed Carl to pass through a closed door.

*Please note that foreign spies introduced these errors to the game. The infiltrators are jealous of the peaceful, happy lives our citizens lead!
The Ministry of Audiovisual Affairs has corrected minor defects in the character animations and eradicated a number of graphical artifacts.
Thanks to the Ministry of Dates and Numbers, the date and time format of saved games now corresponds to the language selected in the game's settings.
[/olist]
While pleased with these achievements, the new cabinet still faces many laborious challenges. Fortunately, the prime minister – ex-Minister of Agriculture has sharpened his skills to work without eating or sleeping! This means our country will continue to grow and our citizens will become even happier!
Finally, the first major achievements of the Ministry of DLC, the youngest Ministry, are coming this spring!
